name: Veggie Basic Soup
description: A hearty vegetable soup made with a variety of vegetables and flavorful broth.

recipeInstructions.text: In a large pot, melt butter over medium heat. Cook onions, carrots, and celery until the onion is translucent.
Stir in tomatoes, beef broth, soya sauce, Worcestershire sauce, parsley, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes or until the vegetables are tender and flavors are well blended.

keywords: vegetable soup, beef broth, savory soup

_similar.name: Tomato Macaroni Soup
_similar.description: A hearty and comforting soup featuring macaroni, vegetables, and a rich tomato broth.

recipeInstructions.text: Saute onion, celery, and carrot in oil until tender.
Add stock, juice, and water. Bring to a boil.
Add pasta and cook until tender.
Add garlic salt and Worcestershire sauce.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.

_similar.keywords: tomato macaroni soup, comfort food, pasta soup

_similar.name: Thai Chicken
_similar.description: A Thai-inspired chicken dish with spaghetti, vegetables, and a tangy sauce, served hot or chilled.
recipeIngredient: 2 tsp Sambal Oelek or hot pepper sauce

recipeInstructions.text: Cook pasta according to package directions for the minimum time. Drain, rinse with cold water, and drain again.
Stir pasta in a large bowl to coat with sesame oil.
Finely grate the peel from 1 lime and squeeze juice to measure 1/4 cup. Stir juice, peel, soya sauce, hot pepper sauce, salt, and sugar into pasta.
Slice chicken into bite-size pieces, thinly slice pepper, onion, and celery, and julienne carrots.
Stir-fry chicken in batches and return to the pan with garlic and onions. Stir-fry about 3 minutes.
Stir in water, peppers, celery, and carrots. Continue stirring about 3 minutes, adding a bit more water if necessary.
Add snow peas and stir about 1 minute.
Toss with the pasta, serve right away, or chill overnight and serve cold the next day.

_similar.name: French Onion Soup
_similar.description: A classic French onion soup made with caramelized onions, consomme, and topped with melted mozzarella cheese and croutons.
recipeIngredient: 4 Oxo cubes dissolved in 2 cups hot water

recipeInstructions.text: Melt butter. Saute onions until transparent.
Add to Oxo, consomme and water. Simmer about 2 hours.
Put in onion soup bowls, add a slice of French bread on top of each one and add shredded mozzarella cheese sprinkled over each.
Put in oven at 350°F for 30 minutes.

_similar.keywords: French onion soup, caramelized onions, melted cheese

_similar.name: Richard's Sunday Soup
_similar.description: A rich and comforting soup featuring carrots, potatoes, and chicken stock.

recipeInstructions.text: Peel and dice the carrots and potato. Combine diced onion and oil in a saucepan and cook over medium heat.
Add the diced carrots and potato to the onion and cook for 3 minutes.
Add chicken stock and sugar. Cook for 2 minutes.
Reduce heat to simmer and cook for 10 to 15 minutes or until the vegetables are cooked.
Remove from heat and puree. Serve immediately with fresh bread.

_similar.keywords: carrot soup, potato soup, chicken stock

_similar.name: Spaghetti Sauce
_similar.description: A rich and flavorful homemade spaghetti sauce made with tomato paste, tomato sauce, and ground beef, simmered for several hours.

recipeInstructions.text: Combine all ingredients except ground beef in a large pot. Cook gently for at least 2 hours.
Sauté the ground beef until browned, drain off fat, and add to the sauce.
Continue cooking gently for another 2 hours.

_similar.keywords: spaghetti sauce, homemade tomato sauce, Italian sauce
